name: Kruger Motors
description: South Africa's leading manufacturer of rugged, reliable SUVs and trucks.
story: Kruger Motors has a long history of supporting local motorsport, viewing it as the ultimate test for their vehicles' durability and performance. They seek partnerships with teams that demonstrate a commitment to excellence and a strong connection with the South African market. Kruger Motors believes that motorsport sponsorships enhance brand visibility and showcase their engineering prowess to a passionate audience.
